blind_final_approach.why: at the fixed floor grasp posture the own camera sees 0 beam pixels, so the pre-close beam track estimate is None there (BEAM_UNCERTAIN -> PREGRASP_NOT_READY, DEV probe raise_high_align 3358372e r1); camera placement and field of view unchanged
blind_final_approach.method: look-then-move: the unchanged pre-close check (visual beam track + stationary clearance) runs at the hover, the last calibrated posture where the beam is visible, plus the band's lateral centre on the fixed station line within the align tolerance; then the fixed hover -> grasp descent (71 mm vertical, no base motion) and the unchanged close barrier run blind from that confirmation and own issued commands
blind_final_approach.limits: blind window <= fixed descent + CLOSE_WAIT_S + close ramp + 0.5 s slack; issued commands inside the fixed path envelope (no base motion, no pan change, no gripper reopen); drop <= 0.075 m, horizontal <= 0.002 m; resting track age <= 30 s and sigma <= 50 mm / 3 degrees
blind_final_approach.inputs: own RGB at the hover, measured hover camera model, own issued commands; no ground truth, contact/success flag or shared camera
blind_final_approach.residual: a partner nudge of the resting beam during the blind window is not detected before the close; post-close own-grip detection + partner signal stays deferred (grip_monitor log-only)
blind_final_approach.status: DESIGN_DRAFT: offline replay of one recorded descent (r1); no closed-loop run
